# §5′ — 5′→0′ = 1/0

## #0 — The positions retain what produced them

The final Process table gathers operations already performed on the field. The two retained singles and their four composites gave six positions. T1 placed those positions in a geometry and gave traversal a direction. T0 read them under the slash, recovered a complete field inside each parent, and brought the two phases into relation. Harmonics and complementary folds then made their different groupings explicit. The positions arrive with these relations intact.

The native terms remain `0`, the singular One; `1`, the polyvalent All; and `/`, their relating activity. A positional index such as `#4` locates a determination. A binary value, a slash-form, a qualitative determination and a number in the formal count are different readings at that location. Their exact convergence depends on preserving which operation supplied each one.

The [Binary Explication's §5′ table](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) **sources** this final gathering. [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **defines** its place within the complete eightfold: parent relation and return-switch bracket the six determinations. The names below carry the work earned through those determinations; they are not instructions to give every field page the same six semantic headings.

## #1 — One address holds distinct exact readings

The [curated core spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **grounds** the qualitative determinations alongside File Two's geometric and proportional table:

| Position and name | Qualitative determination | Binary character(s) | Binary value or pole | T1 placement | T0 slash reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #0 Ground | `0/1` | `0` | Negation-pole | Centre / Point | `(0/1)/(1/0)` |
| #1 Definition | `?/!` | `00` | 0 | North / Line / 0° | `0/0 = %` |
| #2 Dynamis | `−/+` | `01` | 1 | East / Angle / 90° | `0/1` |
| #3 Pattern | `X/x` | `10` | 2 | West / Triangle / 270° | `1/0 = ?/!` |
| #4 Context | `AM/IS` | `11` | 3 | South / Square / 180° | `1/1 = 100%` |
| #5 Realisation | `∞/dx` | `1` | Affirmation-pole | Circumference / Circle | `(1/0)/(0/1)` |

The table preserves a productive displacement. `?/!` is the qualitative determination at #1 and the native expression for the zero-denominator limit at #3 in the slash register. `0/1` names Ground qualitatively and occupies #2 as an explicit slash-form. These are different offices of the notation, recoverable from their columns rather than resolved by moving one into the other's address.

The numerical rules remain exact. `00,01,10,11` have base-two values `0,1,2,3`. As ordinary quotients, `0/1=0` and `1/1=1`; both `0/0` and `1/0` are undefined. `%` and `?/!` preserve their native QL meanings without becoming extra scalar values. [A03](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the relation between exact determination and the condition it cannot exhaust.

The geometry also keeps its operation: `N→E→W→S` includes the 180° East-to-West leap. The strings supply the ordered count and the source supplies their cardinal placement. The table carries both, so the leap remains legible within the final pattern.

## #2 — Count and cause ask different questions at the same position

Formal QL counting begins at #1 and returns to #0. The core's count crosswalk is

| Position in traversal order | Formal-count number | Question | Causal work in the native process reading |
|---|---:|---|---|
| #1 Definition | 1 | What | The material given that enters an account |
| #2 Dynamis | 2 | How | Efficient activity, force and transformation |
| #3 Pattern | 3 | Who/Which | Formal organisation and repeatable pattern |
| #4 Context | 0 | Where/When/Why-Thus | The situated horizon in which the account holds |
| #5 Realisation | 4 | Why-For | Achieved integration and what it makes possible next |
| #0 Ground | 5 | Why-So | The enabling condition of the whole passage |

The sequence of positions is `1,2,3,4,5,0`; the corresponding formal numbers are `1,2,3,0,4,5`. The offset at #4 is exact: zero enters Context, four goes to Realisation, and five to Ground. The count is read by function after the first three, rather than by equating each number with its positional index.

The causal column follows the source's material ingression, efficient dynamism, formal pattern, contextual horizon and achieved integration, held by their ground. It is a native account of what the positions do. The source's questions distinguish the enabling “Why-So” from the consequential “Why-For”; the contextual “Why-Thus” asks after this situated configuration. These offices do not turn the table into a historical attribution of six causes to another philosopher.

[A15](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **grounds** the precision of keeping count and account distinct. The formal number at a position does not replace the operation through which that position becomes answerable.

## #3 — Context contains the full person relation

Across the six positions, the person sequence runs first person at #1, second at #2, third at #3, contextual holding at #4, recognition at #5, and pre-perspectival return at #0. The source also refers to a full personhood nested within Context. The [native expansion of the AM/IS nesting] **sources** its explicit local coordinates:

| Within outer #4 | Person office | Relation carried |
|---|---|---|
| #4.0 | Pre-personal ground | The condition from which a personal address arises |
| #4.1 | First person | `AM`, the knower |
| #4.2 | Second person | `/`, the relation and means of encounter |
| #4.3 | Third person | `IS`, the known or sayable |
| #4.4 | Meta-personal | The three held within one circumstance |
| #4.5 | Trans-personal | Recognition of their unity |

The nested count is three person offices plus their ground, giving `3+1=4`, then contextual holding and recognition, giving `(3+1)+2=6`. This is a count of the stated offices. It does not identify outer #4 with nested #4.4, or make #4.0 the formal-count zero merely because both use the character zero. Their coordinate prefixes specify the scale.

The source's *pramātṛ/pramāṇa/prameya* mapping gives knower, means and known three related placements: numerator/slash/denominator in an act of knowing; `.1/.2/.3` within personed Context; and Being/Becoming/Knowing across the three harmonic pairs. [A05](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **compares** this native Śaiva-register reading. [A06](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A06-Vak.md) **extends** the second-person address that keeps the means from disappearing between knower and known. The mappings retain their distinct scales while articulating one relation.

## #4 — A crosswalk has to preserve every operation it connects

Context gives a worked test of the consolidated table. At outer #4, the binary string `11` has value three. Its slash reading `1/1` has value one. Its formal-count number is zero. Its qualitative determination is `AM/IS`, and its nested person field has six offices. Each statement is exact in the operation that produces it. Substituting one value for another would lose the very convergence the table is meant to disclose.

The wider field makes #4's relation equally explicit. It belongs to the Knowing harmonic `{4,5}` and the Constitution fold `{1,4}`. It is the last of the four explicates `{1,2,3,4}` and the first station of the recognition sequence `{4,5,0}`. Their intersection is `{4}`. Context holds these relations together while permitting their differences to remain informative.

The primary `3:3` is the subject sequence `1–2–3 / 4–5–0`. The first three articulate perspectives; the return is one recognition through void, one and `0/1`. It is therefore also `3:1`. The three harmonics and three complementary folds supply another comparison, not the origin of that subject sequence. [A02](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **grounds** the identification through difference that permits these maps to meet without exchanging their meanings.

Reading a position in this way is an actual operation: select its address, recover the relevant column, perform that column's rule, and return the result with its rule still attached. The result can then be compared with another reading of the same position. The source calls the lived practice of such recursive, discriminating reading Epi-Logos.

## #5→0 — The account returns as an activity of reading

The Process file closes under `§5′→0′ — 1/0 = / ≠ 0/1`. The returned relation carries both the placed figure and its proportional depth:

$$
0/1=4+2=5\to0=1/0=4'+2'=5'\to0'=0/1.
$$

The [Process contract](README.md) **defines** this full vantage. Its primes mark File Two's inverse-phase positions; File Three's Night-pass primes name another sequence. Definition and Quilt retain the short `0/1=4+2=5→0=0/1` statement. The completed Process reading has made the intervening inverse and its returns available for inspection and traversal.

The source names the grammar Quaternal Logic: the four explicate positions articulate a relation whose two implicate poles remain active. Epi-Logos names its lived recursive reading—an account becoming material for an account of how it was made. The native claim concerns the determining activity that the grammar makes explicit. Its use requires recovering the operation at each position and the return by which its result enters the next field.

A computational use must retain the actual transformation and return: what was inherited, which operation changed it, what was kept, and what the result makes available for another pass. The table supplies exact distinctions for that work; a stateful implementation has to realise them through its own storage and transition rules. The source's image of paired cycles does not by itself establish a minimal machine or a phenomenal subject.

The page **returns-to** [Movement 25](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md) and [Matheme](../README.md). [A36](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **extends** the return in which the achieved sign keeps its precision while making its source relation newly readable. The positions remain a field that can be operated, each determination carrying its inherited relations and its way onward.
